title: Environment Variables & Shell State
task: Run bin/show-mode.sh with Bash in preview mode and save stdout in preview.out. Then run it in release mode and save stdout in release.out. Try a one-command assignment for the first run and an export for the second.
hints: Read the script and find the name it consumes.
After export APP_MODE=release, the same command inherits release. Use > to capture each result.

checks.label: The preview command received its environment value
checks.feedback: Set APP_MODE=preview on the command that runs the script.

checks.label: The release command received its environment value
checks.feedback: Export APP_MODE=release or set it for the command, then capture release.out.
